findings.description: The setup reservation pipeline atomically bridges Git worktree creation and process evidence without intermediate unleased state. Reservations store a timestamp-free lease_intent, conservatively block sync points as indeterminate provisioning, and derive lease timestamps from the final publication transaction.
findings.resolution: Maintain the generation-fenced setup reservation state machine and publication-time lease construction.

findings.description: Lease ownership is strictly bound to the exact (owner, lease_id, controller_instance_id) triple across acquire, resume, renew, release, teardown, and recovery. Expired takeover requires proof of stale same-host process evidence and clean durable state, issuing a fresh lease and controller identity while force-adoption appends to an immutable recovery audit.
findings.resolution: Keep the locked atomic transaction discipline and exact-triple ownership verification across all mutation boundaries.

findings.description: Autopilot run recovery state is stored outside disposable worktrees under monotonic generation CAS and requires proving the exact live registry triple and entry generation before mutation. Recreating a removed checkout validates the exact durable ref tip SHA against durable_head and hashes the raw loop state blob prior to worktree instantiation.
findings.resolution: Preserve the identity-bound recovery envelope and exact-tip SHA validation during autopilot resume.

findings.description: The prerequisite preflight completes as an authoritative feature-HEAD barrier in the shared feature worktree, verifying merge ancestry and surface assertions under the branch lock before satisfying DAG dependencies or constructing dependent package worktrees.
findings.resolution: Retain the synchronous feature-HEAD barrier and locked ancestry revalidation sequence.

findings.description: PR delivery stage classification uses a 4-way truth table over changed files and base state, failing safe to ambiguous on diff truncation or marker conflict. Operator overrides are restricted to ambiguous state, bound to RFC-8785 canonical classification digests (pr-delivery-v1+jcs-sha256), and append invalidation events to operator_override_history whenever SHA or ruleset bindings change.
findings.resolution: Maintain pure classifier stage routing, canonical JCS digest bindings, and append-only override history tracking.

findings.description: Schema v2 registry readers maintain seamless backward compatibility with v1 entries, mapping legacy pinned=true to GC retention while reserving active status for unexpired leases or fresh legacy heartbeats. The pin and unpin aliases remain non-blocking GC controls without granting write leases.
findings.resolution: Sustain dual-read registry parsing and the explicit separation of GC retention from activity leases.

findings.description: The mutating skill inventory comprehensively classifies all 24 repository-mutating entrypoints and consumers across standalone, continuous, child, hybrid sync-point, sync-point, and registry-reader modes, backed by automated scan tests that prevent unclassified lifecycle drift.
findings.resolution: Enforce the comprehensive inventory mapping and automated consumer verification scan.
